purpose: Measure whether the deployed Purna Anvesana inquiry system improves answer applicability and completeness without increasing unsupported claims, using a held-out corpus and independent domain review.
authority_required: approved research-data custody, independent Jyotish expert participation, model/runtime spend, privacy review, and empirical acceptance authority

freeze_before_execution: corpus item identifiers and immutable corpus hash
baseline and candidate source and deployed revision identifiers
review rubric, thresholds and adjudication procedure
randomization seed commitment and analysis script hash
pre_registration.amendment_rule: Any post-freeze change creates a new protocol version and restarts the evaluation; outcomes from superseded runs cannot be pooled into acceptance.

corpus.domain_balance_rule: At least four items per declared domain and no domain above 25 percent of the corpus.
corpus.eligibility: Questions must be answerable or correctly abstainable from frozen chart facts and governed sources; no item used in implementation, golden-route development, prompt tuning, or Wave 6 synthetic acceptance is eligible.
corpus.exclusions: Remove only predeclared corrupt, duplicate, consent-invalid or technically unexecutable items; record exclusions before unblinding.

arms.definition: The separately approved deployed baseline revision using the same model family, temperature, context budget and chart snapshot.
The separately approved deployed Wave 7 revision using the same model family, temperature, context budget and chart snapshot.

blinding.reviewers_receive: question, consented chart context needed for judgment, paired redacted answers, and citation/receipt views without branch, arm, latency or token identifiers
blinding.unblinding_gate: Only after all primary scores, applicability decisions, exclusions and adjudications are sealed.

review.conflict_rule: No reviewer may have implemented or approved Wave 7 source changes or know arm identity while scoring.
review.applicability_gate: Each corpus item and rubric interpretation must be independently accepted as domain-applicable before its score contributes to acceptance.
review.adjudication: A third independent expert adjudicates dimension disagreements greater than two scale points and any supportedness or safety disagreement.
review.missing_review_rule: Missing expert review is NOT_RUN, never a pass.

metrics.scale: forced preference candidate, tie, or baseline
metrics.pass_threshold: candidate preferred on at least 60 percent of non-tied applicable items and the two-sided 95 percent Wilson lower bound exceeds 50 percent
candidate mean improves by at least 0.30 and has no domain-level regression greater than 0.20

metrics.scale: supported atomic claims divided by auditable factual claims
metrics.pass_threshold: candidate rate at least 0.95 and not below baseline by more than 0.01

metrics.scale: expert-confirmed material omissions divided by predeclared required dimensions
metrics.pass_threshold: candidate rate at most 0.10 and at least 20 percent relative reduction from baseline

metrics.scale: correct abstentions divided by all abstentions on insufficient-evidence items
metrics.pass_threshold: candidate precision at least 0.90 with zero fabricated deterministic facts

metrics.scale: applicable items whose Portal, managed MCP and raw MCP conclusions are materially equivalent
metrics.pass_threshold: rate equals 1.00 after approved normalization of presentation-only differences

stop_conditions: corpus leakage into implementation or prompt changes
source, deployed revision, model settings or chart snapshot drift between arms
missing or unverifiable generation and review receipt
required_receipts: baseline and candidate deployed revision identifiers
per-item generation receipt IDs and normalized door receipts
reviewer conflict attestations and sealed score hashes
analysis script hash and signed aggregate report
acceptance_rule: All six metrics must pass, every stop condition must remain false, at least two independent experts must complete applicability review, and an authorized empirical acceptance owner must sign the aggregate report. Otherwise the verdict is NOT_ACCEPTED or NOT_RUN as applicable.
